title: Psoriasis consultation
what: A dermatologist examines your skin, nails, and joints and chooses treatment. Psoriasis is not contagious, and it can be kept under control.
why: For red, scaly patches on the skin, itching, or nail changes; or to choose or review treatment.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes; treatment is planned for the long term
tell_doctor: When the rash appeared and what makes it worse
Which ointments and medicines you have tried

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: The day before the visit, do not put ointment on the patches, so the doctor sees the skin as it is, unless your doctor said otherwise.

prepare.title: Photos
prepare.text: Take photos of the rash during a flare-up, if it is better now.

bring: A list of your medicines and ointments
Tests and reports from past doctors
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms and treatment
The doctor checks your skin, scalp, and nails
You are asked about your joints
feel: Sometimes the doctor gently scrapes off a few scales to look closer
after: Use the treatment regularly, even when it gets better, as your doctor says
Do not stop medicines on your own. Tell your doctor. They will decide
red_flags: Red skin over almost the whole body, chills, or a fever: see a doctor urgently

faq.a: No. You cannot catch it from another person.

faq.q: Can psoriasis be cured for good?
faq.a: Usually not completely, but treatment can clear the rash for a long time so you can live comfortably.

reminders.text: Dermatologist visit soon. Bring a list of the ointments and medicines you have tried.
